title: Genetic and Functional Analysis of Aplasia Cutis Congenital (ACC)
brief_summary: The goal of this research study is to identify genes and regulatory elements on chromosomes that cause ACC. The investigators also study tissue samples from patients to learn about the processes that lead to this disorder.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ACC; unaffected individuals only if part of a participating ACC family

Exclusion Criteria:

* No ACC unaffected individuals only as part of a participating ACC family
